name: tiktok-api
description: TikTok profile, videos and Content Posting (Open API), plus comments and DMs (Business API), via the official TikTok APIs

nodes.title: Get TikTok user info
nodes.description: Read the authorized TikTok user's profile (display name, username, follower and video counts). Fields need the matching user.info.* scopes.

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: List TikTok videos

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Query TikTok videos

nodes.title: Refresh TikTok access token
nodes.description: Exchange a refresh token for a new access token. TikTok rotates refresh tokens: store the returned refresh_token. The client secret is read from TIKTOK_CLIENT_SECRET only.

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Publish TikTok video
nodes.description: Post a video from a public URL on a verified domain. mode=direct posts it (needs privacy_level); mode=inbox sends it to the creator's TikTok inbox as a draft to finish in the app.

video_url.description: Public video URL on a domain verified for the app

title.description: Caption with #hashtags and @mentions (direct only; inbox drafts are captioned in the TikTok app)

privacy_level.description: Required for direct posts; must be one of creator_info.privacy_level_options. Unaudited apps can only use SELF_ONLY.

brand_content_toggle.description: Paid partnership promoting a third party

wait.description: Poll the status every 5 s (up to 5 min) until TikTok finishes

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Publish TikTok photos
nodes.description: Post 1-35 photos from public URLs on a verified domain. mode=direct posts them (needs privacy_level); mode=upload sends them to the creator's inbox to finish in the app.

photo_urls.description: 1-35 public image URLs (one URL may be passed as a plain string)

privacy_level.description: Required for direct posts; must be one of creator_info.privacy_level_options. Unaudited apps can only use SELF_ONLY.

photo_cover_index.description: Index of the cover photo in photo_urls
